_about: COUNTY RUN, the endless survival mode (src/modes/county_*.gd, CLAUDE.md 'County Run'). Every number and every word on a reward card is here: change it, restart the run. Upgrade ranks are 1-based; 'per' is what one rank adds. {v} in a card's text is the value at the rank being offered, {now} at the rank held, {gun} the weapon's name.

maps.title: HICKSTON
maps.blurb: STOREFRONTS, ALLEYS AND BACKYARDS. THE SALOON AND THE FEED STORE GO RIGHT THROUGH.

maps.title: THE QUARRY
maps.blurb: HAUL ROADS, TERRACED PITS, SHEDS AND A CATWALK OVER THE CUT.

maps.title: GATOR BAYOU
maps.blurb: BOARDWALKS OVER THE MUCK, SHACKS ON STILTS, OPEN GROUND TO CIRCLE IN.

tips: ONE CARD IS ALWAYS FOR THE GUN IN YOUR HAND.
1-3 PICK A SLOT. THE WHEEL CYCLES YOUR GUNS.
XP WON'T COME THROUGH A WALL. GO GET IT.
EVERY TENTH LEVEL IS A MILESTONE: THREE BIG PICKS.
A LULL IS THE TIME TO RELOAD AND SWEEP UP XP.
ELITES DROP A PILE OF XP. THEY'RE MARKED GOLD.
B SHOWS YOUR BUILD. THE WORLD WAITS.

xp._about: XP to go from level L to L+1: first + step*(L-1) + curve*(L-1)^2. Each kill drops max health / per_hp XP (at least 1), elites times elite_times.

spawn._about: Minutes of survival raise the cap on live enemies, the rate and the mix (a map's "pressure" scales the cap and the rate). A lull every lull_every seconds holds new spawns for lull_for. Elites come every elite_every seconds from elite_from.
